Name: Immersive Dialogue UI
Author: heyitsmads
Description:
Immersive Dialogue UI reworks the dialogue box UI to make it feel more immersive, by moving NPC portraits out of their frames and into the "world", with a small vanilla-style nameplate below them.

It doesn't change anything about how dialogue actually works, is compatible with all UI recolours and most portrait mods, and configurable to tune to your liking.

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Technically compatible with all portrait mods. However if portraits are "cut off" (eg: overflow the portrait frame in vanilla dialogue UI) they might look a bit weird when sitting outside of the dialogue box[/*]
[*]Compatible with UI recolours, since Immersive Dialogue UI doesn't add any new UI elements, just re-uses vanilla assets[/*]
[*]Technically compatible with mods that add backgrounds to portrait frames etc, but this mod will make them redundant because there is no portrait frame[/*]
[*]Likely incompatible with other mods that alter the dialogue box UI itself, especially those that also use DDFC (see requirements below)[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22678]Dialogue Display Framework Continued[/url]: the framework that makes this UI rework possible. Note that the original mod ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11661]Dialogue Display Framework[/url]) has now been updated to 1.6, but still has some small bugs (eg: cursor flashing when using controllers) so this mod depends on Continued until those are resolved[/*]
[/list]
